# P152: Profile System Production Readiness — Acceptance Tests

**Purpose:** Testable acceptance criteria for profile calibration and ear count implementation.
**Usage:** Ralph Loop iterates until ALL tests pass (score 100%).

## Test Scoring

Score = passed_tests / 9 (shown as X/9 or N%)
Total tests: 9
Pass threshold: 9/9 (100% — all tests must pass)

---

## Category 1: Calibration Display (3 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Visitor sees calibration when ≥5 sessions
**Given:** Profile user has 5 verification sessions
**When:** Visitor navigates to `/p/{slug}` (not logged in)
**Then:**
- "Understanding Calibration" label visible below profile name
- Blue calibration bar with indicator dot visible
- Tapping/hovering dot shows tooltip with calibration state
- Tooltip includes session count ("Avg ... over 5 sessions")

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + manual inspection

---

### UAT-1.2: Owner sees own calibration
**Given:** Logged-in user viewing own profile with ≥5 sessions
**When:** User navigates to `/p/{own-slug}`
**Then:**
- Same calibration display as visitor view
- "Create Story" button visible (owner-only)
- Share button visible in top-right corner (owner-only)
- Calibration tooltip shows same information

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot comparing visitor vs owner view

---

### UAT-1.3: Calibration hidden when user has <5 sessions (KISS)
**Given:** Profile user has only 2 verification sessions (insufficient)
**When:** Any user (visitor or owner) navigates to `/p/{slug}`
**Then:**
- Profile loads successfully without errors
- "Understanding Calibration" section NOT visible (component not rendered)
- Profile header, tabs, and other content work normally
- No empty state message, no progress indicator, no CTA button (KISS approach)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + verify no calibration-related elements

---

## Category 2: Ear Count Badge (3 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Ear count badge visible when >0 ears
**Given:** Profile user has 3 successful understandings (ears)
**When:** Any user views the profile
**Then:**
- Ear badge (gray icon + number "3") appears inline next to profile name
- Tapping/hovering badge shows tooltip: "{Name} understood 3 stories as confirmed by their owners"
- Badge visible on both mobile and desktop

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot + tooltip inspection

---

### UAT-2.2: Ear count badge hidden when 0 ears
**Given:** Profile user has 0 successful understandings
**When:** Any user views the profile
**Then:**
- Ear badge does NOT appear next to profile name
- No "0 ears" badge visible (clean header)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot

---

### UAT-2.3: Ear count updates when new ears achieved
**Given:** Profile user initially has 2 ears
**When:** User completes a verification session with speaker_rating ≥ 8
**Then:**
- Ear count updates to 3 (trigger updates `profiles.ears_count`)
- Badge reflects new count after page refresh

**Verify:** Database query + screenshot before/after

---

## Category 3: Layout Consistency (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Owner vs visitor layout identical (visual)
**Given:** Profile with calibration data
**When:** Comparing owner view (`isOwner=true`) and visitor view (`isOwner=false`)
**Then:**
- Profile header layout identical (avatar, name, ear count, calibration)
- Stories/Points tabs appear in same position
- Only differences: "Create Story" button (owner), share button (owner)

**Verify:** Playwright MCP side-by-side screenshots

---

### UAT-3.2: Mobile and desktop responsive
**Given:** Profile with calibration data
**When:** Viewing on mobile (375px width) and desktop (1440px width)
**Then:**
- Calibration bar scales to fit container (min 100px, max 140px)
- Ear count badge wraps to new line if name is long (mobile)
- All touch targets ≥44x44px on mobile

**Verify:** Playwright MCP mobile + desktop screenshots

---

## Category 4: No Regression (1 test)

### UAT-4.1: Existing functionality works
**Given:** Profile page after P152 implementation
**When:** Performing existing actions
**Then:**
- Logged-in visitors can click position buttons on points (verify in Points tab)
- Profile owners can create stories via "Create Story" button
- Story/Point cards navigate to detail pages on click
- Share button opens ShareDialog modal (owner view)
- Back button returns to previous page

**Verify:** Manual click-through on production or staging
